spacing_scope: Human:space only your own checks;shared GPU idle required
rationale: Distinct fixed mechanism removes shared bucket atomics,initialization and publication scan. CPU compiles preserve zero spills and original shared allocation. It is not a rerun of e5. No exposure/time gain inferred from logical counts.

design.measurement_units: Repeated cold-L2 graph timing within one job;not independent GPU jobs
design.controls: Same real weights,shape,input and inherited baseline;all unchanged M>8 paths retained
design.randomization_limitation: Balanced deterministic reversal,not a randomized multi-job confirmatory study
design.selection: Strict>3%each population/order;actual selected scored profile required
design.statistics: No formal significance claim from one job or replay pseudo-replicates

stop: No gate relaxation,no marginal-timing retry,no automatic score or Decode integration. If no qualifying new path,close this norm aggregation avenue pending materially different evidence.
